name: meetstream
description: Three flows: the Bot API (AI meeting bots for Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams: record, transcribe and summarize calls, stream transcripts and audio live, auto-join from your calendar); agents in the meeting on your own stack (a bridge server with any models, including local ones, or your own agent through the Agent Kit); and the hosted Agents API (voice agents) - over the hosted MeetStream MCP server.
